The '''CY-M Prototype''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was part of [[HK-47]]'s [[HK-47's Droid Army|droid army]]. It was similar in appearance to a [[Chirq Council Mechanized Guardian]] and was armed with a red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==History==
[[File:CY-MPrototype.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The CY-M Prototype, wielding a [[red]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].]]
One such unit was destroyed on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] proceeding to destroy [[HK-47]]. Another recovered by [[Andal Sait]]'s troops and delivered to his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']], as part of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral's]] collection. Sait organized a ceremony to present to various officers and dignitaries his newest acquisition. However, unknown to all the guests, a group of undercover [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] aboard the Star Destroyer altered the programming of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The CY-M, armed with a large [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-axe]], jumped into the crowd and started swinging its weapon in a deadly move. However, the droid was soon pushed into a nearby [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], which was immediately opened into space.<ref name="DS">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

Some of these droids were also known to have carried [[CY-M ink rifle]]s, [[Geonosian sonic blaster/Legends|CY-M carbines]] and [[CY-M sword]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
CY-M Prototype droids appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
